entities.summary: Alcinda Helena Panguana is a boxer from Mozambique. She competed in the women's welterweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics. She won against Elizabeth Akinyi in the Round of 16. She lost to China's Gu Hong in the quarterfinals. Alcinda Panguana was a athletes & competitors from Maputo (b. 1994-02-27, Maputo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
